$schema_doc: Phase 18 Group D Task 18 — single source of truth for every model the local AI runtime knows about. Compile-time pinned via include_str! in crates/aec_ai/src/registry.rs::ModelRegistry::embedded so adding / updating a model is a JSON edit, not a Rust code change. BLAKE3 / sizes / URLs must be verified end-to-end (download → blake3sum → file size → tally) before being added; never paste an unverified hash. Schema is versioned (`schema_version`) so future migrations can detect a pre-D registry written by an older binary.

text.$doc: Ternary-Bonsai 1.58-bit GGUF Q2_0 text models — one per hardware tier. Verified during Phase 18 Group A (PR #92) by downloading each file from prism-ml's HuggingFace LFS endpoint and hashing with BLAKE3. The hashes here MUST match the ones in `ModelTier::canonical_blake3_hex` exactly — `model_manager.rs::model_tier_filenames_match_huggingface_repos` + the new `registry::tests` pin that round-trip.

image_gen.$doc: Image-gen presets — curated list of small-SD-family GGUFs the first-run wizard offers as one-click downloads. Each entry must have been verified end-to-end (download → blake3sum → file size) before merge. The presets array is INTENTIONALLY EMPTY in the current ship: shipping fabricated hashes for SD models we haven't downloaded-and-hashed in this session would be the exact failure mode the registry exists to prevent. Operators who want to add a verified preset edit this array; the first-run wizard reads the same JSON. Users with a HF URL we don't curate paste it in the wizard's manual entry field (`apps/desktop/renderer/src/components/ImageGenWizardPanel.tsx`).
